descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name meaning 'YHWH has strengthened,' spelled variously as Chizkiyahu, Chizkiyah, Yechizkiyahu. Primarily refers to Hezekiah king of Judah (c. 715-686 BC), the righteous son of Ahaz who removed high places, broke the bronze serpent, and trusted YHWH against Sennacherib's siege (2 Kgs 18-20; 2 Chr 29-32; Isa 36-39). Also borne by an ancestor of Zephaniah (Zeph 1:1), individuals in genealogies of 1 Chronicles (1 Chr 3:13, 4:41), heads of families among post-exilic returnees (Ezra 2:16; Neh 7:21), and a signatory of Nehemiah's covenant (Neh 10:17). Used in headings of Proverbs (Prov 25:1) and Isaiah (Isa 1:1).
